bio.short: I'm the UX designer who also ships AI tools. At Bibel TV a platform-configured support copilot is live in production, and for a donor-funded nonprofit I built an AI fundraising workflow end to end. I prototyped against real APIs with Claude Code, built design systems for agentic use, and worked with external engineering from that code.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I led product design and built AI tools that run in production. A platform-configured support copilot drafts viewer-services replies from the support handbook while people keep every send decision. A color-extraction API with its own configuration tool and a design-token API run alongside the copilot. For a donor-funded nonprofit I also built an AI fundraising workflow end to end. It runs from performance analysis through a Claude Project with follow-up loops to a web prototype and a shipped Claude skill. ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude support my research synthesis, data analysis and prototyping; Claude Code is where the building happens. An MCP prototyping server is in active development.

The design systems support the same working model. The four-tier token architecture I built serves iOS, Android, web and connected TV from one CI-enforced source, with Storybook as the source of truth and checks that refuse off-system work. I prototyped in real code against production APIs, and external engineering worked from that code. Before Bibel TV I owned the design system and established joint governance with engineering at Ninox, where I later designed prompt-to-database AI onboarding with the CEO and technical co-founder. At Datameer I defined component behavior and specifications while the UI designer shaped the visual system for an analytics platform used by banks and insurers.

The same approach rests on research that ends in product decisions: a viewer survey program that set the Bibel TV redesign direction, in-person shop-owner interviews at Spreadshirt that overturned an executive assumption, and a ChurchDesk booking capability that cut coordination time by 70% with 90% acceptance. I've taught AI-for-design workshops to an agency's designers and developers, and mentored designers through CareerFoundry. German native, based in Berlin, working remotely.

context.emphasis: Shipped AI systems in production, named individually (support copilot, fundraising ecosystem, colour-extraction API + config tool, token API); design systems deliberately built for agentic/LLM use — CI-enforced token source, closed vocabulary, Storybook as source of truth; prototyping in real code against production APIs that external engineering builds from; multi-model AI practice (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) across research, analysis and prototyping with Claude Code as the build tier; research-to-decision with real numbers; senior UX craft in Figma, IA and interaction design; German native, 100% remote in Germany.
